answer_1.outputs: Generated outputs include predicted labels for classification tasks (e.g., sentiment, emotion, question class) and toxic text strings.

answer_2.quote: We use two standard metrics to evaluate the effectiveness of poison attacks: Attack Success Rate (ASR) measures the percentage of non-target-label test instances that are predicted as the target label when evaluating on adversarial dataset instances. A higher ASR indicates a more effective attack; and Clean Accuracy (CACC) measures the model's accuracy on the clean test set.
